newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania net average wage 13.5 pct up in July.
newsitem.headline: Romania net average wage 13.5 pct up in July.

text.p: The average net wage in Romania rose by 13.5 percent in July from June following wage indexation and compensation to cover a 7.5-percent inflation rise, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed.
ROMANIAN AVERAGE WAGES JULY 96 JUNE 96 JULY 95
NOTE: The CNS said purchasing power rose by 5.6 percent in July from June and by 8.8 percent year-on-year. It said July's purchasing power was 73.8 percent of the 1990 level.
Employees in the banking sector had the highest net wage of 621,291 lei on average in July when workers in the health and social security sectors had the lowest pay of 235,710 lei.
Romania employed 5.875 million people at end-July, 10,200 more than the previous month. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
